mapper.select: SELECT POLL_ID, TITLE, START_YMD, END_YMD, USE_YN, REGIST_DT FROM POLL WHERE POLL_ID = #{pollId}
SELECT ITEM_ID, POLL_ID, ITEM_NM, ORDR, VOTE_CNT FROM POLL_ITEM WHERE POLL_ID = #{pollId} ORDER BY ORDR, ITEM_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POLL ( POLL_ID, TITLE, START_YMD, END_YMD, USE_YN, REGIST_DT, REGISTER ) VALUES ( #{pollId}, #{title}, #{startYmd}, #{endYmd}, #{useYn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{register} )
mapper.update: UPDATE POLL SET TITLE = #{title}, START_YMD = #{startYmd}, END_YMD = #{endYmd}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDUSR = #{updusr} WHERE POLL_ID = #{pollId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POLL_ITEM ( ITEM_ID, POLL_ID, ITEM_NM, ORDR, VOTE_CNT ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, #{pollId}, #{itemNm}, #{ordr}, 0 )
